responsibility: This file implements GCC’s SIMD-clone generation support for OpenMP 'declare simd' and related automatic cloning. As an IPA pass it decides whether functions are eligible for explicit or implicit SIMD cloning, parses declare-simd clauses into cgraph_simd_clone metadata, consults target hooks to choose vector sizes and ABI variants, creates and mangles clone declarations and bodies, adjusts parameter and return types for vector calling conventions, and links the resulting clone graph so vectorized callers can select target-specific SIMD entry points.
same_name_distinction: Implements the IPA SIMD-clone subsystem: eligibility checks, parsing of 'omp declare simd', target hook consultation, clone creation/mangling, signature/body adjustment, and the simdclone pass. Unlike gcc/omp-simd-clone.h, it contains the cloning logic itself rather than only the external entry point declaration.
